broadcasts.message: normalize.js unchanged and correct. NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single space, trim. No extra modifications. Tokenizer and pipeline look compatible.

Tokenizer remains as implemented: tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. Returns array in input order, empty array for no matches. No shadowing of normalize. Works with current normalize and pipeline. Ready for next rounds.
Pipeline confirmed compatible with normalize.js and tokenizer.js. Frequencies object uses null prototype to safely handle 'constructor'. No changes needed this round.
